changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table accords (id bigint generated by default as identity, date_passage date, etat boolean, nom varchar(255), refus varchar(255), refusable boolean, text TEXT, title varchar(255), valide varchar(255), adherent_id bigint, adhesion_id bigint, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table activites (id bigint generated by default as identity, age_max integer, age_min integer, autorisation_parentale boolean not null, certificat_medical boolean not null, charte_amicale boolean not null, complete boolean not null, duree bigint, duree_vie_certif integer, genre varchar(255), globale_specifique boolean, groupe varchar(255), groupe_compta varchar(255), groupe_filtre varchar(255), horaire varchar(255), horaire_debut time(0), jour smallint check ((jour between 0 and 6)), lien varchar(255), majoration boolean, nb_places integer, nom varchar(255), prise_en_charge boolean not null, reinscription boolean, salle varchar(255), tarif integer, vie_club boolean not null, salle_id bigint, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table activites_nm1 (id bigint generated by default as identity, activite_id bigint, groupe varchar(255), groupe_filtre varchar(255), horaire varchar(255), nom varchar(255), salle varchar(255), tarif integer, adherent_id bigint, tribu_id bigint, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table adherent_referent_activites (adherent_id bigint not null, activite_id bigint not null, primary key (adherent_id, activite_id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table adherents (id bigint generated by default as identity, adresse varchar(255), adresse_representant boolean, code_postal varchar(255), complet_adhesion boolean, email_representant boolean, genre varchar(255), lieu_naissance varchar(255), mineur boolean, naissance date, nom varchar(255), prenom varchar(255), telephone varchar(255), telephone_representant boolean, ville varchar(255), representant_id bigint, tribu_id bigint, user_id bigint unique, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table adherents_cours (profs_id bigint not null, cours_id bigint not null, primary key (profs_id, cours_id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table adhesions (id bigint generated by default as identity, date_ajout_panier date, date_changement_statut date, deja_licencie boolean, flag boolean, inscrit boolean, majoration boolean, position integer, rappel boolean, remarque_secretariat varchar(255), statut_actuel varchar(255), tarif integer, valid_document_secretariat boolean, valid_paiement_secretariat boolean, activite_id bigint, adherent_id bigint, sur_classement_id bigint, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table adhesions_paiements (adhesion_id bigint not null, paiements_id bigint not null unique);

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table confirmation_token (id bigint generated by default as identity, created_at timestamp(6) with time zone, expires_at timestamp(6) with time zone, token_hash varchar(64) unique, token_type varchar(32) check ((token_type in ('EMAIL_CONFIRMATION','PASSWORD_RESET'))), used_at timestamp(6) with time zone, user_id bigint, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table google_agenda (id bigint generated by default as identity, couleur varchar(7) not null, is_visisble_app boolean default true not null, nom varchar(100) not null, source varchar(500) not null, primary key (id), unique (source));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table historique (id bigint generated by default as identity, date_envoi timestamp(6), echecs integer, listing varchar(255), nombre integer, subject varchar(255), primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table notification (id bigint generated by default as identity, date timestamp(6), raison varchar(255), adherent_modif_id bigint, adherent_visite_id bigint, adhesion_modif_id bigint, adhesion_visite_id bigint, user_id bigint, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table paiements (id bigint generated by default as identity, date_reglement date, montant integer, type_reglement varchar(255), primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table paramnumber (id bigint generated by default as identity, param_name varchar(255), param_value integer, primary key (id), unique (param_name));

changeSet.author: adhesion

changeSet.author: adhesion

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table planifications_hebdomadaires (id bigint generated by default as identity, descriptif varchar(100), duree bigint, horaire_debut time(0), jour smallint check ((jour between 0 and 6)), activite_id bigint not null, salle_id bigint, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table pwa_session_token (id bigint generated by default as identity, expires_at timestamp(6) with time zone not null, session_version bigint not null, token_hash varchar(64) not null unique, used_at timestamp(6) with time zone, user_id bigint not null, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table salle (id bigint generated by default as identity, adresse varchar(500) not null, couleur varchar(7) not null, nom varchar(100) not null, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table seance (id bigint generated by default as identity, cause_annulation varchar(255), commentaire varchar(255), debut timestamp(6), descriptif varchar(100), etat_seance smallint check ((etat_seance between 0 and 3)), fin timestamp(6), activite_id bigint, planification_id bigint, salle_id bigint, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table tribus (id bigint generated by default as identity, uuid uuid, primary key (id));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table user_role_names (user_id bigint not null, role_name varchar(32) not null check ((role_name in ('ROLE_USER','ROLE_SECRETAIRE','ROLE_BUREAU','ROLE_MEMBRECA','ROLE_ADMIN','ROLE_COMPTABLE','ROLE_ENCADRANT','ROLE_REFERENT'))), primary key (user_id, role_name));

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: create table users (id bigint generated by default as identity, email_valid boolean, password varchar(255), session_version bigint default 0 not null, username varchar(255), primary key (id), unique (username));
